cycles.method: No static count and no event counter (waived by the owner, sdk/approvals). On the unit, six Kit loads while playing moved the CPU meter 0.1 points with no skipped render, and a Kit load's longest frame matched a stock Part switch's (TESTING.md).

load.method: Hardware, not cfmeter: an MKII on a development twin of base 0.8 (95adb64b), 24 November 2026, package c1cb63e5, no other module installed. Pattern C16 playing with crossfader sweeps, ten CPU readings and the frame guard per run. Stock with six Part switches (PART+arrow), then Kits as a trial with six LOAD KIT loads: the frame guard's longest frame interrupt 49.3 % and 49.0 % of a frame, the CPU meter 41.8 % and 41.9 % (idle taken as 100 less the meter); stock without Part switches: 40.9 %, 41.8 %. No skipped render (TESTING.md).
